panel_design: Six disjoint chronological intervals per heat; alternating development/test; early/middle/late; wavelength starts 0.08,0.40,0.72 of available span. No panel is reused across splits.
selection: Heat-macro mean NRMSE with equal scenario weights; interpolation independently selected; anomaly configuration maximizing development macro F1 under incremental FPR <=0.005. Ties choose lower complexity.
quality_reference: Scoring-only fixed physical admissibility: finite, 0<Y<64000. No test-value derived anomaly masks. All eligible held points are scored including naturally suspicious readings; additionally report strict positive finite unsaturated scoring (Y<65535).
visibility: Hide geometrically selected cells BEFORE mask/detector/noise/temporal weights. Random hiding independent of intensity. Full time/wave bands hidden regardless of reference eligibility. Model selection never reads test score. Development/test panels disjoint; multiple seeds are repeated measures, heat is sampling unit.
scope: Stratified native-coordinate local panels for controlled experiments; ten full native matrices for final refit and solver audit. Panel recovery conclusions do not establish full-heat predictive generalization. No test-based changes allowed after LOCKED.json.
